eligibility.additionalInfo: The Commonwealth Private Bank Account is only available to personal customers over 18 years of age and have an Australian residential address.

The Commonwealth Private Bank Account is available to non-personal customers who have a domestic business, an ABN or ACN with signatories aged 18 and above or signatories after 16 to 18 with another signatory being at least 18 years old; or be a foreign company that carries on business within Australia, registered with ASIC and be determined on a case by case basis.
